properties.notes: Hybrid application for the comprehensive mixed use redevelopment of car parks and associated land between Strawberry Place and Gallowgate. Detailed application for 172 student bed spaces (45 x 2-6 bed clusters) within a building of 9 storeys (with basement level plant space) (86.1m AOD) with 164sqm of ground floor commercial space (A1-5/D2), and 218 student bed spaces (49 x 2-6 bed clusters) within a building of 11 storeys (85.45m AOD)
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
